item.title: Porous material can arrange disordered gas molecules into a crystal-like structure, study predicts
item.description: [Climate & Environment] Keyword: global warming — Capturing carbon or storing hydrogen to combat global warming requires compressing gases into sponge-like porous materials. Until now, gas molecules were thought to adsorb in a disordered manner throughout the pores. But what if invisible gas molecules could be lined up in regular order—like ice crystals or LEGO bricks?
